blocks.text: The opening formula, “when Jesus had finished these words,” is one of five repeated formulas that organize Matthew’s larger collections of teaching. It marks a transition here, though readers should not assume that the five-fold pattern proves a single, universally accepted symbolic outline. The discussion of divorce, including its exception language, and the threefold saying about eunuchs have also been understood in differing ways; the passage itself places them within teaching about marriage, children, and discipleship.
